title: Not worth the money
text: Not worth the money. The description indicates that the labels are chrome on the jar lids, but they are actually clear stickers with a black leaf insignia (I guess it’s supposed to be a spice plant) with white lettering. The lids themselves are plastic and do not fit snugly. The rack is nice but the  lids are practically useless. jars and labels are not very impressive. The spices come in individually labeled foil pouches and the assortment is of spices that you normally don’t use on a regular basis. Dried crushed mint, dried parsley and pizza seasoning to name a few. I will keep it only because I don’t want to go through the hassle of repacking everything and going to a shipping store. I definitely do not recommend this product.
